# DraftReview

A shared draft's changes, to review one by one. It shows the draft with each change's new text underlined (tinted when an agent wrote it) and its removed text struck through, each numbered, then one row per change with who made it, when and what it was based on, and Accept and Reject. Accept all and Reject all join them while there is more than one change. Screen readers hear each change's number and whether it adds or removes text, and each button names its change ("Accept, Change 2"). Accepting and rejecting are a person's decisions: the callbacks receive the click event so the app can check it came from a person, and an agent does not call them. A change is decided once: its buttons say they are unavailable (`aria-disabled`) and ignore presses until the change leaves `changes`, or until the app keeps it (renders it again with no save of it pending: return the save's promise from the callback). The bulk buttons do the same while one change is decided, and the changes' buttons after a bulk press. When a decided change leaves the list, focus moves to the change now in its place. With no changes it renders nothing, and focus moves to the next control after it; move it elsewhere, such as the draft, if you prefer.

```tsx
import { DraftReview } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/draft-review/draft-review";
```

## Example

```tsx
<DraftReview segments={review.segments} changes={review.changes} onAccept={accept} onReject={reject} onAcceptAll={acceptAll} />
```

## Use instead when

- Use `DraftEditor` instead to write the draft together; DraftReview never edits text itself.

## Props

Type: `DraftReviewProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `acceptAllLabel` | `string` | `"Accept all"` | The bulk accept button's words, for other languages. |
| `acceptLabel` | `string` | `"Accept"` | The Accept button's word, for other languages. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | More buttons at the end of the header, such as Approve. |
| `agentLabel` | `string` | `"Agent"` | The badge on an agent's change. |
| `changeLabel` | `((n: number) => string)` | (n) => `Change ${n}` | What screen readers hear before a change's text and after its buttons' words. |
| `changes` (required) | `readonly DraftChange[]` |  | The pending changes, in reading order. They are numbered in that order, in the text and in the list. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Layout only: width, margins, grid placement (`mt-2`). Appearance classes warn in development. |
| `deletedLabel` | `string` | `"removed"` | What screen readers hear for taken-out text. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | One quiet line after the heading ("Since you last edited"). |
| `heading` | `ReactNode` | `"1 change to review"` or "3 changes to review" | The heading. |
| `insertedLabel` | `string` | `"added"` | What screen readers hear for put-in text. |
| `label` | `string` |  | What screen readers hear for the review. Without it, the review is named by its heading. |
| `onAccept` (required) | `(id: string, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => unknown` |  | Called when the person accepts a change. The click event comes second, so the app can check `event.isTrusted` and act only on a person's click: accepting is a person's decision. Return the save's promise when it is saved later: the change stays decided until it settles. |
| `onAcceptAll` | `((event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => unknown)` |  | Adds Accept all while there is more than one change. |
| `onReject` (required) | `(id: string, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => unknown` |  | Called when the person rejects a change, with the click event to check, as `onAccept`. |
| `onRejectAll` | `((event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => unknown)` |  | Adds Reject all while there is more than one change. |
| `onShowSource` | `((id: string) => void)` |  | Adds Show after a change's `source`, to show what it was based on. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` |  | Reaches the rendered element. |
| `rejectAllLabel` | `string` | `"Reject all"` | The bulk reject button's words, for other languages. |
| `rejectLabel` | `string` | `"Reject"` | The Reject button's word, for other languages. |
| `segments` (required) | `readonly DraftReviewSegment[]` |  | The draft with the changes in place, in reading order. |
| `showSourceLabel` | `string` | `"Show"` | The Show button's word, for other languages. |

## Native attributes

Also accepts the attributes in React's `HTMLAttributes` (`id`, `aria-*`, event handlers), passed to the rendered element, except those named on this page.

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `diff`: Not a prop. The text with the changes in place is `segments`: `<DraftReview segments={segments}>`.
- `onApprove`: Not a prop. Accepting calls `onAccept`: `<DraftReview onAccept={(id) => accept(id)}>`.
- `onDecline`: Not a prop. Rejecting calls `onReject`: `<DraftReview onReject={(id) => reject(id)}>`.

## `className` is for layout only

Pass margins, width and grid placement (`mt-4`, `w-full`, `col-span-2`). Your classes always win over Ouro UI's: DraftReview merges `className` last with `cn` (tailwind-merge), so a class that conflicts with its own replaces it.[^layout-classes]

Appearance comes from props, not classes. In development, a class that sets appearance logs one warning per component instance, naming the prop to use instead. A class sets appearance when, after its variants (`hover:`, `sm:`) and any `!` are removed, it starts with `bg-`, `text-`, `border-`, `rounded-`, `shadow-`, `font-`, `ring-`, `from-`, `via-`, `to-`, `fill-` or `stroke-`, or is `border`, `rounded`, `shadow` or `ring`, or has a `dark:` variant. Text wrapping, overflow and table layout classes (`text-wrap`, `text-ellipsis`, `border-collapse`) are layout and do not warn.

Alignment classes (`text-center`) warn too: set alignment on a parent element.

## Types

### `DraftChange`

One pending change to the draft, with who made it and what it was based on.

```ts
interface DraftChange {
  /** Identifies the change; `onAccept` and `onReject` receive it. */
  id: string;
  /** A person or an agent. An agent's change is marked as the agent's, in the text and in its row. */
  author: "human" | "agent";
  /** Who made it ("Ouro", "Ada Lovelace"). */
  name: string;
  /** When, already formatted ("2 min ago", `<RelativeTime>`). */
  time?: ReactNode;
  /** What it was based on, already worded ("Based on 3 messages"). With `onShowSource`, a Show button follows it. */
  source?: ReactNode;
}
```

### `DraftReviewSegment`

A run of the draft under review: unchanged, put in by a change, or taken out by one.

```ts
interface DraftReviewSegment {
  /** `same` is unchanged text; `insert` is what a change put in; `delete` is what it took out. */
  kind: "same" | "insert" | "delete";
  /** The run's text. */
  text: string;
  /** The `id` of the change an `insert` or `delete` belongs to. */
  changeId?: string | undefined;
}
```
